purpose: Materialize one canonical production bannerOccurrence record for every Stage 1 Korean schedule occurrence using the Stage 2-2 canonical occurrence-to-definition mapping.

schema.bannerOccurrenceId: Canonical occurrence ID frozen by Stage 2-1: bocc:<recordKey>.
schema.bannerDefinitionId: Exactly one canonical definition ID from the Stage 2-2 occurrence-definition map.
schema.sourceOccurrenceKey: Original Stage 1 schedule recordKey retained as provenance.

sourceRelation.effectiveSourceRecordKey: Stage 2 effective CardPool source after verified correction overlay, including null.

scheduleProvenance.bannerCode: Raw schedule bannerCode; not canonical identity.
scheduleProvenance.sourceTypeRaw: Raw Stage 1 sourceType; not normalized taxonomy.
scheduleProvenance.scheduleTypeRaw: Raw Stage 1 scheduleType; not normalized taxonomy.

boundaries: Stage 2-3 does not infer lifecycle NEW/RERUN or any normalized mechanic taxonomy.
Stage 2-3 does not materialize Hero relations, Wish candidate relations, CP/Event relations or canonical Event IDs.
Stage 2-3 does not infer start/end timestamps, timezone, duration or first-ever release.
Stage 2-3 does not treat bannerCode, sourceRecordKey or display image references as canonical definition identity.
Stage 2-3 does not canonicalize assets or perform frontend integration.
Human-readable source names, Hero name lists and selectableText remain in the Stage 1 schedule/source layer for later dedicated consumers; they are not duplicated into the canonical occurrence core.

nextStartPoint.task: Materialize normalized banner taxonomy dimensions without changing canonical occurrence/definition identities.
